status: Prepared before any generality inference; exact artifacts frozen separately before model forward.
registration: Locally timestamped prospective freeze, not independently preregistered. Earlier Japanese Qwen null results were known.
dataset: Two distinct task/language strata; never pooled into one accuracy or treated as translated/paired questions.

physical_schedule.schedule: Seeded shuffled items and within-item physical execution order. Logical policy observations remain replicas 0, then 1, then 2..4.
physical_schedule.averaging: Uniform arithmetic mean of candidate-normalized probabilities aligned to fixed option_0..4 semantic keys; never mean logits.

data.selection: 240 per source split by SHA256(salt+item_id), no gold or model outcomes in selection; JP excludes prior 240 and all earlier project use; English audit recorded in SELECTION.json.
data.limitations: Project-unused public validation items are not pretraining-unseen. Distinct data, prompts, model sizes and languages confound any causal language/family interpretation.

A.definitions: Identical to exploratory/SPECIFICATION.json. Entropy normalized by ln(5); TV=0.5*L1(first,second); rank composites equal weights of outcome-free model-dataset-specific cohort midranks. All scores oriented high=suspected error.
A.uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-question bootstrap resamples; cohort score ranks held fixed; percentile95% intervals and invalid count. Conditional on observed unlabeled cohort.

B.setting: Retrospective batch allocation from newly collected fixed pool; not measured online scheduler or per-request risk predictor.

policies.pair_entropy_tv_rank: All items first two calls. Rank equal midrank pair-mean entropy + TV. Highest priority items complete all5 and return mean5; others return mean2.
policies.pair_mean_entropy: Same two-call start and completion rule, ranked by pair-mean entropy only.
policies.pair_random: Same two-call start and completion rule, selected by fixed SHA256(random_salt+item_id) ascending.
policies.first_entropy: All items first call. Rank first-call entropy only. Selected items complete all5 and return mean5; others return first.

B.allocation: For base b=2 or1, selected count=(budget*N-b*N)/(5-b); require integer, no free probes, no rounding to exceed budget. Pair selected counts0,40,80,160,240. First selected60,90,120,180,240.
B.tie_rule: Descending score, then ascending SHA256(tie_salt+item_id), then item_id; fixed before outcomes.
B.gating_information: First-only policy reads only replicate0 probabilities; pair policies only replicate0 and1. No gold or future member logits in gate.
B.primary_metric: Accuracy contrast at720 physical logical calls per model-dataset stratum (3N), primary Phi-English.
B.uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-question bootstrap on fixed chosen policy predictions, percentile95%. Conditional on realized cohort allocation; no refitting/reallocation in resamples and no overall population policy optimality claim.

interpretation.primary_family: A Phi-English AP difference and B Phi-English accuracy difference estimated descriptively, unadjusted intervals; other three strata and secondary metrics retained, no winner selection or significance claim.
interpretation.retention: All models, scores, budgets, negative and null results retained. No policy retuning, target switching or sample expansion on outcomes.
interpretation.cost: Logical policy cost is the union of selected physical members from a measured five-call pool. Collection actually pays1200 calls per model-dataset,2400 per model,4800 measured total plus56 excluded synthetic checks. Latency sums are replay bookkeeping, not online speedups.
interpretation.fallback: Record incomplete failure; do not replace failed items or silently retry. Resource blocking leaves secondarymodel incomplete.
interpretation.limits: Two unequal-size model families, one Japanese and one English commonsense five-choice task, one Mac, no human participants or independent machine replication. Broader observations do not prove universal utility.

runtime.backend: stock Transformers4.57.6, torch2.12.1, MPS float32 eager
runtime.projection: stock all-position full-vocabulary head; select final position then candidate IDs; logits_to_keep=0 for both checkpoints
runtime.synthetic_checks: 24 Japanese three-type stock full-position repeatability forwards plus2 English choice repeatability forwards and2 bilingual warmups per model;56 excluded in completed v2. Does not establish parity with optimized head.
runtime.failure: Retain partial outputs and stop; do not change dtype, threshold, selection or prompt after model outcome.

revision: v2 after synthetic-only v1 failure with zero benchmark calls. Same questions, prompts, dtype, tolerance, analyses. No benchmark outcome informed this implementation repair.
